plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: 18 Apr 1861 & 1874 (Paul Broca presents patient 'Tan' in Paris and Carl Wernicke maps speech comprehension, proving language is lateralized to the left hemisphere) · 1870 & Dec 1937 (Fritsch & Hitzig discover contralateral motor cortex control in Berlin and Wilder Penfield maps the motor and sensory homunculus in awake patients in Montreal) · 1962–1981 (Roger Sperry and Michael Gazzaniga test split-brain patients at Caltech, proving the 200-million-axon corpus callosum unites two specialized hemispheres and winning the 1981 Nobel Prize).
